product_family: Patent and scholarly research search, analysis, and discovery platform. Integrates 171.8M patents, 315M+ scholarly works, and 560.9M biological sequences with advanced search, visualization, portfolio management, and institutional toolkits for research institutions, academics, and patent professionals.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Users can 'request access to and rectification or erasure of your Personal Data' under European regulations. Data Protection Officer: dpo@lens.org. Third-party security provider is GDPR compliant.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Site-wide search of lens.org and privacy policy yields no mention of SOC 2 certification.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on lens.org domains.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on lens.org domains.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Platform uses AWS but does not claim ISO 27017 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (Cloud PII Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on lens.org domains.

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. GDPR rights are documented but ISO 27701 certification is not claimed.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Product uses ML with Microsoft Academic for search improvement but does not claim AI governance certification.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Product is designed for patent/scholarly research, not healthcare data.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Payment processing through Paddle (third-party, which is GDPR Ready), but PCI DSS not mentioned.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not targeted at US federal agencies.

privacy.ai_training_note: Platform uses machine learning in collaboration with Microsoft Academic to improve search algorithms and metadata quality. Weekly web scans with algorithm improvements informed by community feedback. Training is NOT on customer data or user queries; it operates on open patent and scholarly data sources.
privacy.data_region: AWS global infrastructure (unspecified region, GDPR compliant)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS enabled. HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) implemented to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: No explicit mention. Third-party hosting on AWS (which provides encryption as a service).

security.name: Bot Protection
security.value: Cloudflare Turnstile for bot and DDoS protection on scholarly search endpoints. Cloudflare service is GDPR compliant.

security.name: Data Retention (Web Logs)
security.value: Web server logs deleted every 4 weeks. IP addresses not stored in application databases or analytics servers.

security.name: Data Retention (Guest Accounts)
security.value: Anonymous/guest user accounts deleted within 48 hours.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Standard account-based authentication. Employees use Google Account + YubiKey hardware security keys for 2FA.

security.name: Dependency Security
security.value: Dependabot used for automated dependency scanning and updates.

security.name: Content Security Policy
security.value: Updated CSP to prevent clickjacking attacks.

security.name: Browser Storage
security.value: Local and Session Storage restricted to user's browser. No server-side exchange of stored data.

security.name: Advertising & Tracking
security.value: No ads. No third-party surveillance software. No tracking of user search queries or activity.
